note: Park directly behind the long-running Red Cedar Motel on S Scenic Ave south of Bolivar, near a four-lane highway, with level gravel pull-through sites and two dog parks. No website of its own; directory listings (not the operator) describe 46 full-hookup 30/50A sites, showers and laundry, open all year. Some residents live here full-time (a Google review, 2026). --Claude

WEBSITE: the stored https://www.roverpass.com/c/red-cedar-rv-park-bolivar-mo/ is an UNCLAIMED RoverPass directory page ('Claim my Campground', 'Last Updated: 11/15/2024'); its rate table is not the operator's. No operator website exists - set website to empty (apply.py does not write website).

LONG-STAY (monthly marketed only on the unclaimed RoverPass table, $350/month): (1) price ~$28 reported, under $50 - pass; (2) no nightly rate posted by the operator anywhere (no website, no engine; nightly figures are camper reports and the stale unclaimed RoverPass table) - this would FAIL test 2 if the park were long-stay in character; (3) no minimum stay known; (4) no count of nightly vs monthly sites - the reviews read are mostly travellers ('This is one of the nicest small family RV park we have stayed at in quite awhile... very Big Rig friendly', 4 months ago; 'Check-in process was smooth and quick. Rates are comparable to other similar sites', a year ago); (5) no homes or lots sold. Residents: 'Some people are living here full-time. They actually also have a motel that's been there for 40 or 50 years.' (Google, 4 months ago). Read as a transient highway park with some residents, not long-stay in character - keep, but a human may weigh the no-website/no-posted-rate combination.
